audit_items.proof_trace: Each transaction type uses a unique signing hash function. Typed transactions (AccessList=1, EIP1559=2, Blob=3, SetCode=4) include their type byte prefix in signing hash via BaseAccessListTxDecoder.Encode:24. Legacy transactions use pre-EIP-2718 format without prefix. Domain separation is guaranteed: typed txs have explicit type byte (0x00-0x7f), Legacy starts with RLP structure (0xc0-0xff), and payload structures differ per type.
